name: Explore the city and interact with a landmark
description: Verifies the playable city loads, the player can move, and a nearby landmark can be explored.
steps: Use W A S D to walk toward a landmark
expected: The player moves through the 3D city and the landmark interaction updates the activity notice.

name: Enter a vehicle and switch camera modes
description: Verifies the red car can be entered, driven, exited and viewed with either camera.
steps: Use W A S D to drive and press C to switch camera
expected: Vehicle mode activates, speed responds to input, camera mode changes and the player can exit.

name: Use mobile controls and retain saved progress
description: Verifies mobile controls work and saved player settings persist after reload.
steps: Open the game at a mobile viewport
expected: Touch controls move the character and the saved camera mode and player position are restored.

name: Handle interaction when no landmark is nearby
description: Verifies interaction outside landmark range gives feedback and movement stays inside the playable map.
expected: A helpful no-nearby-interaction message appears and the player remains within the city bounds.
